facts.recommendationText: Design and launch customer loyalty program Create incentive for repeat business and data capture for customer relationship management Systematic retention mechanism replaces transactional, one-time customer model Revenue is declining due to low repeat rate; immediate action to rebuild recurring revenue Points-based or tiered program; benchmark against industry, competitor research Program design reviewed, discount budget allocated Use email or phone-based customer identification to track repeat visits System tested, staff trained, can enroll customer in <30 seconds Send email or in-person invitation to 50+ previous customers; track enrollment rate Email sent to prior customers, enrollment rate >20%, feedback gathered
